title: Lightsheet Staining Protocol
author: Wen-hung Chou
materials: Stain with conjugated antibodies in the dark except for DAPI. Antibodies are used at a 1:200 dilution with PBS with 0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 3% donkey serum, and 10 ug/mL heparin at 37°C for 4 days on a rocker or gentle shaker (≈ 85 rpm). You can stain with up to 4 conjugated-Abs with different fluorophores with excitation peaks near the laser’s wavelengths (405, 488, 561, 640), or 3 conjugated-Abs (488, 561, 640) along with nuclear staining (to be added next step).

steps.title: Fix Tissue
steps.instruction: Fix each tissue of interest in 4% Paraformaldehyde for 24 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples in 1x PBS for 24 hours before proceeding to antibody staining.

steps.title: Tissue Clearing
steps.instruction: Perform tissue clearing using SHIELD polyepoxy and delipidation.

substeps.instruction: Infiltrate samples with SHIELD polyepoxy (PMID: 30556815) for 6 days at 4°C with constant agitation.
Delipidate samples using a SmartBatch+ ETC active tissue clearing platform (LifeCanvasTechnologies, Cambridge, MA).
Place tissue in PBS and transfer to the microscopy core for tissue clearing.

steps.title: Transfer to Glassware
steps.instruction: Transfer samples into a glass dish or vial to prevent DMSO from dissolving plastic vessels.

steps.title: Initial Triton-X100 Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PBS 1X containing 0.2% Triton-X100.

substeps.instruction: Perform 2 washes for 1 hour each at room temperature.

steps.title: Block Tissues
steps.instruction: Block tissues using an incubator shaker with gentle rocking (≈ 85 rpm).

substeps.instruction: Use blocking solution consisting of PBS 1X with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 6% donkey serum.

steps.title: Heparin Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples with PBS 1X containing 0.2% Tween-20 and 10ug/mL heparin.

substeps.instruction: Perform 2 washes for 1 hour each at 37°C.
Add DAPI/Hoechst (1:10000 dilution) to the staining solution.

steps.title: Final Thorough Wash
steps.instruction: Wash samples on a rocker or gentle shaker to reduce background fluorescence.

substeps.instruction: Use PBS 1X with 0.2% Tween-20 and 10 ug/mL heparin.
Perform at least 5 washes for 1 hour each at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer for Imaging
steps.instruction: Bring tissue to the microscopy core in PBS for refractive index matching and imaging.
